title: The next big bets in consumer tech, according to top VCs
byline: Sydney Bradley, Henry Chandonnet, Geoff Weiss
excerpt: Top consumer VCs are betting on AI apps that make the internet more social. They told us the trends they are watching.
content_html:
Investors are hunting for social media startups that can spark new connections and nurture existing ones.

"Social media companies started based on connection," Shawn Carolan, a partner at Menlo Ventures, said of the previous wave of giants like Facebook and Instagram.

Carolan said these companies "evolved into media companies" and abandoned that connection.

That leaves an opening in the market.

Venture capitalists at major firms like Menlo, Forerunner, and A16z have several investors dedicated to backing new and innovative internet startups. Other firms, like Verdict Capital and Premise, were founded by partners at firms like General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and NEA, who wanted to set out on their own with investment theses focused on backing consumer-facing startups building for the AI era.

Niko Bonatsos, cofounder and managing director of Verdict Capital, said that AI is allowing startup founders to "reimagine entire categories" and build "so much faster."

Business Insider recently highlighted 22 VC firms backing social startups in our third annual list. They've invested in startups in broader categories such as social media, AI assistants, and dating apps.

So, where exactly are these top investors placing bets?

Here are 5 categories investors are betting on:

1. Vibe coding — but make it social

Kids and teens are "vibe coding apps," Vanessa Larco, cofounder of Premise, told Business Insider.

She's one of several investors closely watching how vibe coding is being adopted by younger internet users.

Startups like Wabi and Sekai — which are building platforms where people can vibe code mini apps, then share and remix them — have raised millions of dollars from firms like Khosla, A16z, and Connect Ventures.

"People don't want to just watch anymore. They want to create," Connect Ventures' Nicole Quinn said, who invested in Sekai.

Gaming is another opportunity in this category, with tools like Lemonade (an AI agent for creating Roblox mini-games) and ForgeGUI (an AI-powered game design tool for developers) receiving investments from Menlo Ventures and Verdict Capital, respectively.

As Menlo's Amy Wu Martin put it: When the barriers to coding go down, consumers have the realization — "I can make stuff for myself."

It's shifting digital culture, too. Creators who make content about vibe coding or vibe code new apps themselves are emerging.

"Apps are going to be the new media," Patron's Amber Atherton said.

2. New ways to find love

For these VCs, there's love in the air.

A new class of dating apps is challenging the mainstays like Tinder and Bumble. The AI dating app Overtone comes from an icon of the old guard: Hinge founder Justin McLeod. FirstMark's Rick Heitzmann contributed to the company's $18 million raise.

"Probably a year ago, someone would've said 'dating,' I would've been like, 'Ugh, it's a horrible category,'" Heitzmann said. "But then you meet somebody who's thought about the world completely differently, more originally, and better than you have, and it changes your mind."

Many of these startups promise that AI will help ease the awkwardness of dating, either through custom matchmaking or wingman-style assistants. The AI app Sitch is backed by A16z Speedrun and Premise. Its cofounder, Chad DePue, is an investor for Uncommon Projects.

There's also Known, an AI dating service with audio matchmakers, backed by Forerunner Ventures.

Other apps promise users a better dating pool or matching strategy, like the Seven Seven Six-backed Left Field, which pairs based on shared interests and communities.

3. Social apps that get you outside instead of online

There is a bounty of new social startups with the sole purpose of getting people off their screens.

"People are kind of feeling exhausted and maybe a little bit nervous about AI," Precursor's Marina Girgis said. "They want to put their phones down and connect with people IRL."

Abstract Ventures, for instance, backed two social apps built around maps: Corner, for finding and sharing local spots, and Amo, a French app studio behind Bump, which lets you track friends.

Meanwhile, Posh, a platform for IRL events and ticketing, announced a $37 million Series B round led by FirstMark Capital in March.

There are more niche apps for activities, too, like Sweatpals for fitness and wellness, and Swsh for sharing content at live events like music festivals or sporting events.

"As we all lean into AI and we're more efficient with the productivity gains of AI, human beings will have more disposable time," Quinn said. "How do they like to spend disposable time? It's doing what they love."

4. AI companions and personal assistants to help you connect

What if AI agents could actually make our social lives a little bit easier? It's a big question — and it's still heavy on the if — but some investors are placing early bets on this space.

Town, an AI personal assistant for managing inboxes and calendars, announced a $55 million Series A in June. Both A16z and Forerunner participated in the round.

While Town is currently focused on professionals, there are assistant startups for families, too, like Ollie, which helps parents manage household tasks.

If people start to use these AI assistants and companions more and give these tools access to troves of personal data, there could be some unique social applications.

"Someone's going to build this kind of god-like companion that knows everyone and is omnipresent," Shine Capital's Ethan Daly said.

Menlo Ventures' Carolan said he's fascinated by AI-era startups reinventing "the contacts book" to help people connect.

Babylon's Hugo Amsellem sees potential in AI acting as an intermediary between people. He invested in Eigen, a startup that announced $15 million in seed funding this year for an AI "mutual friend."

The space is still quite nascent, however.

5. Entertainment with an AI twist

From music to gaming, entertainment platforms are getting supercharged by AI.

For example, Suno, a platform for making and sharing AI-generated music, has raised hundreds of millions of dollars and announced it was valued at $5.4 billion in June. Menlo Ventures led the company's Series C in 2025.

There's also Lore, a fandom platform powered by AI search, which provides people a new way to "rabbit hole" about their latest pop culture obsessions, "instead of just doing it in Google," said Precursor's Girgis.

Then there are new social gaming apps like Status, an AI mobile gaming startup that lets people role-play as characters, backed by Abstract Ventures and Creator Ventures.

blocks.html_en: "Probably a year ago, someone would've said 'dating,' I would've been like, 'Ugh, it's a horrible category,'" Heitzmann said. "But then you meet somebody who's thought about the world completely differently, more originally, and better than you have, and it changes your mind."

sentences.en: "Probably a year ago, someone would've said 'dating,' I would've been like, 'Ugh, it's a horrible category,'" Heitzmann said.

sentences.en: "But then you meet somebody who's thought about the world completely differently, more originally, and better than you have, and it changes your mind."
sentences.zh: “但当你遇到一个对世界的看法完全不同、更原创、比你更好的人时，你的想法就会改变。”

sentences.en: Many of these startups promise that AI will help ease the awkwardness of dating, either through custom matchmaking or wingman-style assistants.

sentences.en: The AI app Sitch is backed by A16z Speedrun and Premise.
sentences.zh: AI 应用程序 Sitch 由 A16z Speedrun 和 Premise 提供支持。

sentences.en: Its cofounder, Chad DePue, is an investor for Uncommon Projects.
sentences.zh: 其联合创始人 Chad DePue 是 Uncommon Projects 的投资者。

blocks.html_en: There's also Known, an AI dating service with audio matchmakers, backed by Forerunner Ventures.

sentences.zh: 还有 Known，一项由音频媒人提供人工智能约会服务，由 Forerunner Ventures 提供支持。

blocks.html_en: Other apps promise users a better dating pool or matching strategy, like the Seven Seven Six-backed Left Field, which pairs based on shared interests and communities.

sentences.en: Other apps promise users a better dating pool or matching strategy, like the Seven Seven Six-backed Left Field, which pairs based on shared interests and communities.
sentences.zh: 其他应用程序向用户承诺更好的约会池或匹配策略，例如七七六支持的左场，它根据共同的兴趣和社区进行配对。

blocks.html_en: 3. Social apps that get you outside instead of online

sentences.en: Social apps that get you outside instead of online
sentences.zh: 社交应用让你走出去而不是上网

blocks.html_en: There is a bounty of new social startups with the sole purpose of getting people off their screens.

sentences.en: There is a bounty of new social startups with the sole purpose of getting people off their screens.
sentences.zh: 有大量新的社交初创公司的唯一目的是让人们远离屏幕。

blocks.html_en: "People are kind of feeling exhausted and maybe a little bit nervous about AI," Precursor's Marina Girgis said. "They want to put their phones down and connect with people IRL."

sentences.en: "People are kind of feeling exhausted and maybe a little bit nervous about AI," Precursor's Marina Girgis said.
sentences.zh: Precursor 的玛丽娜·吉尔吉斯 (Marina Girgis) 表示：“人们对人工智能感到有些疲惫，或许还有点紧张。”

sentences.en: "They want to put their phones down and connect with people IRL."
sentences.zh: “他们想放下手机，与现实生活中的人联系。”

blocks.html_en: Abstract Ventures, for instance, backed two social apps built around maps: Corner, for finding and sharing local spots, and Amo, a French app studio behind Bump, which lets you track friends.

sentences.en: Abstract Ventures, for instance, backed two social apps built around maps: Corner, for finding and sharing local spots, and Amo, a French app studio behind Bump, which lets you track friends.
sentences.zh: 例如，Abstract Ventures 支持了两款围绕地图构建的社交应用程序：Corner，用于查找和分享当地景点；Amo，Bump 背后的法国应用程序工作室，可让你跟踪朋友。

sentences.en: Corner is a social map for saving and sharing local spots.
sentences.zh: Corner 是一个用于保存和分享当地景点的社交地图。

sentences.en: Corner; Apple App Store

blocks.html_en: Meanwhile, Posh, a platform for IRL events and ticketing, announced a $37 million Series B round led by FirstMark Capital in March.

sentences.zh: 与此同时，IRL 活动和票务平台 Posh 于 3 月份宣布完成由 FirstMark Capital 领投的 3700 万美元 B 轮融资。

blocks.html_en: There are more niche apps for activities, too, like Sweatpals for fitness and wellness, and Swsh for sharing content at live events like music festivals or sporting events.

sentences.en: There are more niche apps for activities, too, like Sweatpals for fitness and wellness, and Swsh for sharing content at live events like music festivals or sporting events.
sentences.zh: 还有更多针对活动的利基应用程序，例如用于健身和健康的 Sweatpals，以及用于在音乐节或体育赛事等现场活动中分享内容的 Swsh。

blocks.html_en: "As we all lean into AI and we're more efficient with the productivity gains of AI, human beings will have more disposable time," Quinn said. "How do they like to spend disposable time? It's doing what they love."

sentences.zh: 奎因说：“随着我们都倾向于人工智能，并且随着人工智能生产力的提高，我们变得更加高效，人类将拥有更多的可支配时间。”

sentences.en: "How do they like to spend disposable time?
sentences.zh: “他们喜欢如何度过可支配的时间？

sentences.en: It's doing what they love."
sentences.zh: 这是在做他们喜欢做的事情。”

sentences.en: AI companions and personal assistants to help you connect

blocks.html_en: What if AI agents could actually make our social lives a little bit easier? It's a big question — and it's still heavy on the if — but some investors are placing early bets on this space.

sentences.en: What if AI agents could actually make our social lives a little bit easier?
sentences.zh: 如果人工智能代理真的能让我们的社交生活变得更轻松一点怎么办？

sentences.en: It's a big question — and it's still heavy on the if — but some investors are placing early bets on this space.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大问题，而且仍然很重要，但一些投资者已经在这个领域进行了早期押注。

blocks.html_en: Town, an AI personal assistant for managing inboxes and calendars, announced a $55 million Series A in June. Both A16z and Forerunner participated in the round.

sentences.en: Town, an AI personal assistant for managing inboxes and calendars, announced a $55 million Series A in June.
sentences.zh: Town 是一款用于管理收件箱和日历的人工智能个人助理，6 月份宣布获得 5500 万美元的 A 轮融资。

sentences.en: Both A16z and Forerunner participated in the round.
sentences.zh: A16z 和 Forerunner 均参加了本轮比赛。

blocks.html_en: While Town is currently focused on professionals, there are assistant startups for families, too, like Ollie, which helps parents manage household tasks.

sentences.en: While Town is currently focused on professionals, there are assistant startups for families, too, like Ollie, which helps parents manage household tasks.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Town 目前专注于专业人士，但也有针对家庭的助理初创公司，例如 Ollie，它可以帮助父母管理家务。

blocks.html_en: If people start to use these AI assistants and companions more and give these tools access to troves of personal data, there could be some unique social applications.

sentences.en: If people start to use these AI assistants and companions more and give these tools access to troves of personal data, there could be some unique social applications.
sentences.zh: 如果人们开始更多地使用这些人工智能助手和伴侣，并让这些工具访问大量的个人数据，可能会出现一些独特的社交应用程序。

blocks.html_en: "Someone's going to build this kind of god-like companion that knows everyone and is omnipresent," Shine Capital's Ethan Daly said.

sentences.en: "Someone's going to build this kind of god-like companion that knows everyone and is omnipresent," Shine Capital's Ethan Daly said.
sentences.zh: Shine Capital 的伊森·戴利 (Ethan Daly) 表示：“有人会打造出这种神一样的伙伴，它了解每个人并且无所不在。”

sentences.en: Menlo Ventures' Carolan said he's fascinated by AI-era startups reinventing "the contacts book" to help people connect.
sentences.zh: Menlo Ventures 的卡罗兰表示，他对人工智能时代的初创公司重新发明“通讯录”以帮助人们联系感到着迷。

blocks.html_en: Babylon's Hugo Amsellem sees potential in AI acting as an intermediary between people. He invested in Eigen, a startup that announced $15 million in seed funding this year for an AI "mutual friend."

sentences.en: Babylon's Hugo Amsellem sees potential in AI acting as an intermediary between people.
sentences.zh: Babylon 的 Hugo Amsellem 看到了人工智能作为人与人之间中介的潜力。

sentences.en: He invested in Eigen, a startup that announced $15 million in seed funding this year for an AI "mutual friend."
sentences.zh: 他投资了 Eigen，这家初创公司今年宣布为人工智能“共同朋友”提供 1500 万美元的种子资金。

blocks.html_en: The space is still quite nascent, however.

sentences.en: The space is still quite nascent, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个领域仍处于起步阶段。

content_html_zh:
投资者正在寻找能够激发新联系并培育现有联系的社交媒体初创公司。

Menlo Ventures 合伙人肖恩·卡罗兰 (Shawn Carolan) 在谈到 Facebook 和 Instagram 等上一波巨头时表示：“社交媒体公司是基于联系而起步的。”

卡罗兰表示，这些公司“演变成媒体公司”并放弃了这种联系。

这给市场留下了一个空缺。

Menlo、Forerunner 和 A16z 等大公司的风险投资家有几位致力于支持新兴互联网初创企业的投资者。 Verdict Capital 和 Premise 等其他公司是由 General Catalyst、Lightspeed Venture Partners 和 NEA 等公司的合作伙伴创立的，他们希望自己的投资论文专注于支持面向人工智能时代的面向消费者的初创公司。

Verdict Capital 联合创始人兼董事总经理 Niko Bonatsos 表示，人工智能让初创公司创始人能够“重新构想整个类别”并“更快地构建”。

Business Insider 最近在我们的第三份年度榜单中重点介绍了 22 家支持社交初创企业的风险投资公司。 他们投资了社交媒体、人工智能助手和约会应用程序等更广泛类别的初创公司。

那么，这些顶级投资者到底把赌注押在哪里呢？

以下是投资者押注的 5 个类别：

1. Vibe 编码——但要使其社交化

Premise 联合创始人凡妮莎·拉科 (Vanessa Larco) 告诉《商业内幕》，儿童和青少年是“氛围编码应用程序”。

她是密切关注年轻互联网用户如何采用氛围编码的几位投资者之一。

Wabi 和 Sekai 等初创公司正在构建平台，人们可以在其中对迷你应用程序进行编码，然后共享和重新混合它们，它们已从 Khosla、A16z 和 Connect Ventures 等公司筹集了数百万美元。

“人们不想再只是观看了。 他们想要创造，”投资 Sekai 的 Connect Ventures 的 Nicole Quinn 说道。

游戏是这一类别中的另一个机会，Lemonade（一种用于创建 Roblox 迷你游戏的人工智能代理）和 ForgeGUI（一种面向开发人员的人工智能游戏设计工具）等工具分别获得了 Menlo Ventures 和 Verdict Capital 的投资。

正如 Menlo 的 Amy Wu Martin 所说：当编码的障碍降低时，消费者就会意识到——“我可以为自己制作东西。”

它也在改变数字文化。 创作有关氛围编码内容或氛围编码新应用程序本身的创作者正在涌现。

“应用程序将成为新媒体，”Patron 的 Amber Atherton 说。

2. 寻找爱情的新方法

对于这些风险投资家来说，空气中弥漫着爱的气息。

新型约会应用程序正在挑战 Tinder 和 Bumble 等主流应用程序。 AI 约会应用 Overtone 来自一位保守派的偶像：Hinge 创始人贾斯汀·麦克劳德 (Justin McLeod)。 FirstMark 的 Rick Heitzmann 为公司筹集了 1800 万美元。

“可能一年前，有人会说‘约会’，我会说，‘呃，这是一个可怕的类别，’”海茨曼说。 “但当你遇到一个对世界的看法完全不同、更原创、比你更好的人时，你的想法就会改变。”

许多初创公司承诺，人工智能将通过定制匹配或僚机式助手来帮助缓解约会的尴尬。 AI 应用程序 Sitch 由 A16z Speedrun 和 Premise 提供支持。 其联合创始人 Chad DePue 是 Uncommon Projects 的投资者。

还有 Known，一项由音频媒人提供人工智能约会服务，由 Forerunner Ventures 提供支持。

其他应用程序向用户承诺更好的约会池或匹配策略，例如七七六支持的左场，它根据共同的兴趣和社区进行配对。

3. 社交应用让你走出去而不是上网

有大量新的社交初创公司的唯一目的是让人们远离屏幕。

Precursor 的玛丽娜·吉尔吉斯 (Marina Girgis) 表示：“人们对人工智能感到有些疲惫，或许还有点紧张。” “他们想放下手机，与现实生活中的人联系。”

例如，Abstract Ventures 支持了两款围绕地图构建的社交应用程序：Corner，用于查找和分享当地景点；Amo，Bump 背后的法国应用程序工作室，可让你跟踪朋友。

与此同时，IRL 活动和票务平台 Posh 于 3 月份宣布完成由 FirstMark Capital 领投的 3700 万美元 B 轮融资。

还有更多针对活动的利基应用程序，例如用于健身和健康的 Sweatpals，以及用于在音乐节或体育赛事等现场活动中分享内容的 Swsh。

奎因说：“随着我们都倾向于人工智能，并且随着人工智能生产力的提高，我们变得更加高效，人类将拥有更多的可支配时间。” “他们喜欢如何度过可支配的时间？ 这是在做他们喜欢做的事情。”

4. AI 伴侣和私人助理可帮助您建立联系

如果人工智能代理真的能让我们的社交生活变得更轻松一点怎么办？ 这是一个大问题，而且仍然很重要，但一些投资者已经在这个领域进行了早期押注。

Town 是一款用于管理收件箱和日历的人工智能个人助理，6 月份宣布获得 5500 万美元的 A 轮融资。 A16z 和 Forerunner 均参加了本轮比赛。

虽然 Town 目前专注于专业人士，但也有针对家庭的助理初创公司，例如 Ollie，它可以帮助父母管理家务。

如果人们开始更多地使用这些人工智能助手和伴侣，并让这些工具访问大量的个人数据，可能会出现一些独特的社交应用程序。

Shine Capital 的伊森·戴利 (Ethan Daly) 表示：“有人会打造出这种神一样的伙伴，它了解每个人并且无所不在。”

Menlo Ventures 的卡罗兰表示，他对人工智能时代的初创公司重新发明“通讯录”以帮助人们联系感到着迷。

Babylon 的 Hugo Amsellem 看到了人工智能作为人与人之间中介的潜力。 他投资了 Eigen，这家初创公司今年宣布为人工智能“共同朋友”提供 1500 万美元的种子资金。

然而，这个领域仍处于起步阶段。

5. 融入人工智能的娱乐

从音乐到游戏，人工智能正在为娱乐平台提供动力。

例如，制作和分享人工智能音乐的平台 Suno 已筹集数亿美元，并于 6 月份宣布估值达到 54 亿美元。 Menlo Ventures 领投了该公司 2025 年的 C 轮融资。

还有Lore，一个由人工智能搜索驱动的粉丝平台，它为人们提供了一种新的方式来“兔子洞”了解他们最新的流行文化痴迷，“而不仅仅是在谷歌中进行，”Precursor 的 Girgis 说。

然后还有新的社交游戏应用程序，例如 Status，这是一家人工智能移动游戏初创公司，由 Abstract Ventures 和 Creator Ventures 提供支持，让人们可以扮演角色。
